title: Chreatures body-local sensorimotor play trajectory
description: NPZ array contract. Partition keys live in the manifest; model arrays contain no resident identity, entity identity, object label, world coordinate, heading, distance, or bearing.

source_senses.description: float32 [T+1,N,351], encoded permitted body-local physical senses in port order

physiology.description: float32 [T+1,N,6]: energy, gut, fatigue, tanh(speed/2), tanh(angular_velocity/4), circuit support

executed_actions.description: float32 [T,N,8], final clipped physical commands in thrust,yaw,gaze_pitch,grip,signal_low,signal_mid,signal_high,posture order

oral_command.description: float32 [T,N], actual eat command supplied by the declared body-state law clip((1-gut)*(1.1-energy),0,1)

reset.description: bool [T+1,N], true only for the first observation of each fresh episode

neural_readouts.description: optional float32 [T+1,N,384] identity-bound full-graph readout view; never substitutes for source_senses
